Fields.Name: Target Normal
Fields.Description: The surface normal the back of the hand aligns to.

Fields.Name: Target Handle
Fields.Description: A handle the hand follows (overrides the position and rotation when set).

Fields.Name: Transform On Fraction
Fields.Description: How much the position / rotation target counts (0 to 1).

Fields.Name: Normal On Fraction
Fields.Description: How much the normal target counts (0 to 1).

Fields.Name: Fade In Duration
Fields.Description: How long the IK takes to blend in, in seconds.

Fields.Name: Fade Out Duration
Fields.Description: How long the IK takes to blend out, in seconds.

Fields.Name: Extrapolation Time Step
Fields.Description: How far ahead the target is extrapolated, in seconds.

Fields.Name: Handle Change Speed
Fields.Description: How fast the hand moves to a new handle, when the change mode is constant velocity.

Fields.Name: Handle Change Mode
Fields.Description: How the hand moves to a new handle: at once (abrupt) or at a constant velocity.

Fields.Name: Fix Up
Fields.Description: Whether the hand's position is fixed up after the rest of the pose.
